source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware by Redfish when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware through redfish.
1. Enter the command on the command line to set the behavior of BMC after update.
Command : curl -k -X PATCH https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/ -H "Content-Type:application/json" -d '{"HttpPushUriOptions":{"HttpPushUriApplyTime":{"ApplyTime": "Immediate"}}}'
2. Change the name of the firmware file to be updated in the green text. This command may take some time to upload the firmware to BMC.
Command : curl -k -X POST https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/update -H "Content-Type:application/octet-stream" --data-binary @${File_name}
3. Waiting for the flash progress complete.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Firmware should be flashed successfully after BMC reset only one time.
curl -k -X GET https://root:0penBmc@${BMC_IP}/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: curl (Redfish REST client, on the BMC side) + BMC image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- BMC downgrade via Redfish (system is off): the agent needs the exact user-provided BMC image first the host must be powered OFF first (flash while system is off), then runs the Redfish update flow: `PATCH /redfish/v1/UpdateService` (set preserve/replace behavior), `POST /redfish/v1/UpdateService` to upload the image, poll the returned TaskService task to completion, then `GET /redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory` to confirm the new version is active after BMC reset only one time. Not a single one-liner; run step-by-step after the image is placed on the BMC.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the full Redfish PATCH/POST response, the TaskService poll loop, and the final `FirmwareInventory` JSON so the user confirms the BMC version changed and the SUT powers on cleanly after the off-state flash.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: BMC firmware flash via Redfish is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; flash only the user-specified image with host powered off for a clean result, and never interrupt mid-flash.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; captures the host-off Redfish lifecycle but lowers capability solely because images/approval are inputs and assumes generic endpoint/task behavior.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; useful security/recovery analysis, but treats approvable project contracts as an irreducible block.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 725/2291 preserves the same-row PATCH/POST/inventory flow.

original_test_intent: Automatically exercise approved BMC firmware upgrade and downgrade through Redfish while the host is off, allow exactly one BMC reset per transition, and prove the active version and subsequent platform recovery.
original_method: With host off and BMC on standby, PATCH Immediate apply, POST the chosen BMC image, wait for completion, then query FirmwareInventory after the single BMC reset and inspect logs.
manual_activity: An authorized engineer approves the immutable firmware/reset plan and final verdict; no manual physical action or visual acceptance is inherent when host power, Redfish update and evidence collection are available through approved APIs.
required_inputs: BMC hardware/current/upgrade/downgrade versions and signed image hashes
Vendor-advertised Redfish action, payload, task and apply semantics
Protected credentials, trusted CA and configuration-preservation expectations
safety_requirements: Do not use embedded URL credentials or `curl -k`; obtain secrets from the approved mechanism and validate the management endpoint.
Discover the target action and task contract rather than assuming `/UpdateService/update` or Immediate apply is supported.
Execute one transition under one unchanged approval; never retry, reverse or add a reset after an uncertain response.
Maintain stable standby power and independent recovery; preserve HTTP/task failures, SEL and reachability loss.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, verify host-off/BMC-on state, capability and image identity; execute one Redfish transition, track its advertised terminal result/reset, collect inventory/health, then power on and collect POST/OS evidence if included.
Report tool status and raw evidence without assigning the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve images, direction/order, host-off/standby, exactly-one-reset and recovery plan.
Interpret management/host health and issue separate direction verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The staged Redfish lifecycle fits, but the supplied source credentials/TLS bypass and assumed endpoint are not safe executable commands. Missing image and approval do not reduce software automation capability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a vendor-approved, capability-discovered UpdateService client with protected credentials and trusted TLS; correlate the update response to its task and account for the single approved BMC reset.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The host-off state, supplied PATCH/POST/GET, one-reset criterion, script and 10/30-minute values remain source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Confirm S5/off with BMC standby, discover the advertised update action and supported apply time, bind a signed image to the BMC inventory member, submit one transition, track the response-correlated task/reset, and independently verify active version, configuration, network recovery, SEL and subsequent host boot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMCs exposing a vendor-approved Redfish update service for their own firmware with host off.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record Redfish schema/service, BMC hardware/firmware/image and client/CA versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Redfish BMC update, reset, configuration-preservation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Removes embedded secrets/TLS bypass and assumed endpoint; adds discovery, task correlation, reset accounting and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Retains both version directions and proves active firmware plus restored management/host lifecycle.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved image/state/reset plan and vendor contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The generic Redfish resource alone does not prove vendor support for a specific image or apply time; capability evidence is mandatory.

project_override_considerations: Projects may select version pairs, apply behavior and automated host-power method. A completed run claims only that approved plan and exactly the observed reset count, not other images or states.
expected_evidence: Approved signed BMC transition matrix and recovery readiness
Redacted request/response plus response-bound task/reset timeline
Pre/post active FirmwareInventory, BMC configuration/health/reachability and SEL
Subsequent host POST/OS evidence when required
Tool result separate from engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe a host-off Redfish BMC update followed by one BMC reset. Exact images, action and reset initiator are approved project inputs; host off is not interpreted as AC removal.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target and state machine are identifiable, and unsafe literal commands can be replaced only after vendor capability confirmation without changing test intent. Readiness inputs do not create permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes PARTIAL to FULLY AUTOMATABLE because images and approval are inputs, while correcting security and endpoint assumptions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves its critical controls but changes BLOCKED because the missing vendor/project contract is identifiable and can be supplied.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates automation capability, execution readiness, tool result and engineer verdict for a destructive API case.

review_improvement: Provides a safe automatable state machine that distinguishes host-off from BMC power loss and accounts for exactly one BMC reset.
independent_technical_reasoning: Every core operation—state verification, Redfish write, task/reset monitoring, inventory and health collection—can be automated under one approved immutable plan. The lack of current images or vendor action details affects readiness, not capability or intent.
